en: Changed Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions to ignore more of a repository's flag and plugin delivery settings; its `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` now acts at most as `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
zh: 变更 Anthropic 托管的云会话，使其忽略更多仓库的 flag 和 plugin 交付设置；其 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` 现在最多只相当于 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`
